title: oxalis scopulorum
intro: Oxalis scopulorum, commonly known as the Rocky Mountain woodsorrel, is a perennial plant that belongs to the oxalis genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Oxalis scopulorum include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
